audit_type: wave-5 still-missing gap audit: post-wave4 regional-skilling-unlocks (harsh)
compared_against: NOTE: scraped-data/audit-regional-unlocks-wave4-still-missing-2026-07-26.json DOES NOT EXIST — wave-5 compares post-wave4 file directly to wave-2 still-missing + id/name fuzzy presence

policy.present_count: Primary id namespace counts by region: prefix before ':' (prifddinas counted under tirannwn for thin-region critique when scoring geography, listed separately in by_prefix).
policy.missing_rule: HIGH-VALUE only: permanent tools, outfits, shops, relics, diaries, production infrastructure, region-defining hubs, or ironman-essential permanent unlocks that materially change no-trade skilling. Training methods / XP rates alone excluded. Combat-only unlocks excluded unless primarily skilling infrastructure.
policy.first_class_rule: Buried inside a hub blurb, pointer sentence, or 'see X' reference that has NO matching id does NOT count as present. Broken outbound references (detail cites id that is absent) are severity=critical.
policy.multi_without_comboLabel_rule: Harsh: any record whose id prefix is multi-region: OR cross-region: with comboLabel=='' counts, PLUS any record with isRegionCombo==true and empty comboLabel, PLUS any record with requiredRegions.length>=2 and empty comboLabel. Single-region rows with empty comboLabel are expected and excluded from this count.
policy.name_dup_rule: Exact name collisions plus near-exact semantic twins that will double-score region power if both are treated as unlocks (same item/activity under two ids).
policy.harshness: Wave-1 catastrophes and wave-2 top-30 are largely FIXED in quantity. Wave-5 attacks (1) broken references, (2) thin starting regions still underweight vs hubs, (3) schema hygiene (all_required abuse, multi prefix without comboLabel), (4) residual ironman permanents never filed as first-class rows.

multi_without_comboLabel.definition: multi-region: or cross-region: prefix with empty comboLabel (isRegionCombo=true empty = 0; requiredRegions>=2 empty = 0)
multi_without_comboLabel.critique: multi-region: toolbelt attaches are deliberately dual-milestone (item + attach) but the multi-region: prefix without comboLabel lies to any consumer that filters on comboLabel. spirit-weaver uses all_required with a single requiredRegions entry and empty comboLabel — schema noise. crystal-teleport-seed-network is hard Tirannwn-only wearing a cross-region: prefix.

summary.verdict: Quantity victory, quality still messy. 550 unlocks is 10× wave-1 and 2× wave-2 — wave-2's critical permanent gaps (Slayer helmet chain, toolbelt attaches, Max Guild, ritual shard, POP, Wilderness sword, Barbarian Training, spirit trees, MTA, crystal trees, totems, Drakan, Nature's Sentinel, master camo, Sticky Fingers, aquarium, gold accumulator, werewolf Agility, fish farm, signs of the porter, constructor/lumberjack, gemstone golem, Shilo mine, Falador shield, Chronicle Attraction, Dark Facet, Polypore, Waiko) are NOW first-class. Remaining failures are: (a) broken outbound id references on Havenhythe Summoning, (b) thin starting-region density vs Misthalin/Kandarin bloat, (c) schema abuse (all_required on singles, multi-region: without comboLabel), (d) deep ironman permanents never promoted beyond footnotes (perfect juju, elven grimoire, god-book base, luck rings, divine charges, tetracompass).

Morytania legs 1–4 still four equipment rows while other diaries collapsed to 1–4 single rows

havenhythe.critique: Starting region still thinnest primary namespace (16 vs Misthalin 83). Wave-1/2 catastrophic emptiness is FIXED (BGH, Moonrise, birdhouses, fish farm, shrine hub). NEW critical failure: shrine hub detail claims havenhythe:empowered-summoning-obelisks and havenhythe:jackalope-familiar as canonical rows — BOTH IDS ABSENT from regional-skilling-unlocks.json. That is worse than a missing unlock: the file gaslights the planner.

karamja.critique: Automatic_early region improved from 0 → 26. Habitat / juju / witchdoctor / gloves / Jadinko / Brimhaven / nature altar / Shilo / pirates' hook / TokKul-Zo present. Still thin relative to elective hubs, and calquat is double-filed. Perfect juju production remains a pointer, not a production unlock. Nature's Sentinel is multi-region (not Karamja-primary) — correct for craft path, weak for curly-roots region scoring.

tirannwn_plus_prif_note.critique: Do not treat Tirannwn as thin — Prif is split into prifddinas: namespace. Combined ~49 is mid-pack. Max Guild / crystal trees / ritual shard / Chronicle Attraction now first-class.

quality_issues.title: Broken outbound id references (file lies)
quality_issues.problem: Detail text treats these as sibling unlock rows. Hygiene/boundary anti-rows may be intentional non-unlocks, but empowered-obelisks / jackalope / skillchompa-supply / orthen-superheat-autoheater / ectofuntus-first-age-outfit are product unlocks that simply never landed. Fix by adding the row or rewriting the detail to stop naming phantom ids.

quality_issues.title: all_required abused on single-region rows (24 records)
quality_issues.problem: regionRequirementType=all_required with empty requiredRegions and empty comboLabel is schema pollution. These are singles. Any consumer that treats all_required as multi-region will mis-score.

quality_issues.problem: See summary.multi_without_comboLabel. Purpose statement requires multi-region unlocks to carry comboLabel. Toolbelt attaches and spirit-weaver violate that contract.
